title: Source-size budget, warn-only
goal: An optional report of files over a threshold
acceptance: `core/tools/check-source-sizes.mjs` lists tracked source files over `sourceSize.maxLines` (default 600) from `.harness.json`; it never fails the build; absent setting means off
Fixtures: under, over, excluded path, setting absent
Failing test committed first: the over-threshold fixture expects the file named against an empty tool; the change never edits that test to pass
privacy: Neutral content only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git. Fixtures are invented.
validation: npm run check:fast; final applicable CI
escalation: Material scope growth or effort increase goes to the owner before adoption

effort.basis: The report's 1.5 h. Estimated 2026-11-26 at agent speed from the report's effort column. Not a measurement.
